name: wirestate
description: Visual, executable state-machine specifications for applications

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.json && cp -R public dist/public && cp -R schema dist/schema
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run example:build && node --test tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build && npm run example:build && node --experimental-test-coverage --test --test-coverage-include=dist/*.js --test-coverage-exclude=dist/cli.js --test-coverage-lines=90 --test-coverage-functions=90 --test-coverage-branches=75 tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run example:build && npm run test:coverage && npm run build
scripts.example:serve: npm run build && node dist/cli.js serve --cwd examples/habit-tracker
scripts.example:check: npm run build && node dist/cli.js check --cwd examples/habit-tracker
scripts.example:smoke: npm run build && node dist/cli.js smoke generate --cwd examples/habit-tracker --machine habits.app --out examples/habit-tracker/tests/generated.smoke.spec.ts
